title: Cold rebuild: parametrized grade boundaries
summary: Write the pytest grade tests again from an empty editor.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *pytest for xUnit people* you covered every edge of `grade` with `parametrize`. Write it again from an **empty editor**.

steps.title: Grade boundaries in pytest, cold
prompt: `grades.grade(score)` returns "A" from 90, "B" from 80, "C" from 70, "D" from 60, else "F", and raises `ValueError` outside 0 to 100.
Write parametrized tests (both sides of every boundary, and the refused scores with `pytest.raises`), at least 10 cases.
